summary: This video guides beginners through the Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive workflow for Apple Vision Pro, from hardware setup and on-set tips to a complete post workflow in DaVinci Resolve 20.1. It covers camera settings (iris, built‑in NDs, frame rate, shutter angle, and flicker considerations), on-set monitoring and I/O (SDI, timecode, 10G data port), and offloading. The tutorial then dives into immersive editing in Resolve: enabling the Immersive workflow, resolution and proxy choices based on hardware, color management tailored for Vision Pro, and importing Blackmagic RAW. It expands into advanced tools like Edge Blend, Lens Space/LatLong, text graphics in lens space, Fusion tools for removing unwanted elements, and an ASAF-based Ambisonic workflow with head-tracking monitoring using AirPods. Finally, it covers Vision Pro delivery options (AIVU previews, Vision Pro Bundle, ASAF, VR180) and how to stream to multiple Vision Pros, framing the workflow as a practical, end-to-end pipeline from unboxing to a finished immersive video.
